tools.name: chroma_create_collection
tools.description: Creates a collection, optionally with HNSW configuration.

tools.name: chroma_peek_collection
tools.description: Shows a sample of documents in a collection.

tools.name: chroma_get_collection_info
tools.description: Returns detailed information about a collection.

tools.name: chroma_get_collection_count
tools.description: Returns the number of documents in a collection.

tools.name: chroma_modify_collection
tools.description: Updates a collection's name or metadata.

tools.name: chroma_add_documents
tools.description: Adds documents to a collection, with optional metadata and custom IDs.

tools.name: chroma_query_documents
tools.description: Runs semantic (vector) search over a collection with advanced filtering.

tools.name: chroma_get_documents
tools.description: Retrieves documents by IDs or filters, with pagination.

tools.name: chroma_update_documents
tools.description: Updates a document's content, metadata or embeddings.

tools.name: chroma_delete_documents
tools.description: Deletes specific documents from a collection.
